ground_truth_notes: Synthetic Tempus xT mock report — Phase 1 scoring is restricted to the report_metadata section. Genomic_Variant / other_molecular_biomarker / tested_biomarker umbrellas are emitted as empty placeholders to satisfy the always-emit-all-4-sections rule; they will be hand-labelled and scored in Phase 2/3.
Vendor inferred from the 'xT' product marker (upper-right of page 1) — Tempus genomic profiling panel. No explicit 'Tempus' wordmark.
Practice 'Doyle PLC' is the ordering physician's institution, NOT the testing vendor.

No MRN field — Tempus uses 'ID #' (same value as Accession Number 4643). Per strict MRN rule, Patient_MRN = null. Accession is captured only in this notes block (no Accession_Number field in schema v2 report_metadata).

Ordering physician and signing pathologist share the same name 'Jennifer Walker' (mock-data quirk in source corpus); signing_pathologist is not a schema-v2 field, so the name lives only in the ordering provider slot.
Procedure left null: the report does not literally print a procedure name (e.g. 'Next Generation Sequencing'); xT is the product/panel, not the methodology phrase.
